name: web-cart-checkout-success-and-tracking-screens-in-black-and-white
title: Four fashion-store flow screens on black: cart, checkout, payment success modal and order-tracking map
whatItIs: A black board with four white desktop screens: cart with product rows and order review with a black Checkout and purple and yellow express buttons; a two-column checkout form with a grey summary; a dimmed page with a payment success modal and outline illustration; and an orders tracking page with a map route.
whatItMeans: Clear and calm; monochrome UI with just purple and yellow express buttons.
techniques: Keep the UI black and white.
Show a modal with a line illustration.
Pair order timeline with a map.

vocabulary.definition: Fast pay buttons above a form.
A list of steps with dates and addresses.
A map showing a delivery path.
